gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-titillium-web: Happy Monkey draws its curves as stout as its stems, with wide gaps in the e that make it feel loud and friendly. Titillium Web, a plain sans, is lighter, and a small heading would lose that punch.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tomorrow: Happy Monkey holds a ruler-straight stroke with wide gaps in the e. Its strongest quality is that bold, chunky confidence, which Tomorrow's cupped, sans-serif bowls leave plenty of room to breathe around.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-trispace: Distinctive from the first glance, Happy Monkey has diagonals as stout as its uprights and a bold, upright stance. Trispace follows with sparse, widely set letters whose curves open outward, giving the heavy heading plenty of space.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Happy Monkey brings a bold, ruler-straight stroke and wide gaps in the e, so every word feels stamped and confident. And Tsukimi Rounded, a sans-serif with parallel edges through its round forms, makes the quieter counterpart.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tuffy: Bold is the first impression of Happy Monkey, with its ruler-straight strokes and wide gaps in the e. Then Tuffy, a sans-serif sketched as if with a pencil that never presses harder, steps in with a steadier voice.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-urbanist: Contemporary but still a bit cheeky, Urbanist trails a single-width line like a rolling-ball pen. Under Happy Monkey's bold heading, a long passage of it would move along smoothly, never curling shut.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-varela: Varela, a modern sans, gives its t a crossbar and stem of one width, and its c shapes look like a wide mouth. But Happy Monkey, bold and ruler-straight, supplies the loud heading that Varela relaxes beside.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-varela-round: Modern and clean, Varela Round frames its counters with same-width strokes and wide-mouthed rounds in the lowercase. But beneath Happy Monkey's bold heading, a long passage of it would read gently and without fuss.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-varta: Varta reads with big open eyes on every e and a, friendly and contemporary. Varta across a longer stretch stays easy on the eye, while Happy Monkey's crossbars, fat as their stems, carry the heading's weight.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-vazirmatn: Approachable and modern, Vazirmatn keeps a wide-open s that never tightens. But a long passage of it flows easily beneath Happy Monkey, whose steady line shows no pressure variation at all.
